summary: Closed audit trail for the live Disable Audio Enhancements card. VM probes proved the documented MMDevices endpoint enhancement values are protected by Windows ACLs on the current build, so the app now reports this card as not applicable instead of attempting a misleading root-level or access-denied mutation.

setting.name: Disable Audio Enhancements
setting.casual_explanation: This card checks whether Windows exposes the audio enhancement endpoint keys, but does not try to write protected MMDevices values.
setting.why_people_change_it: People look for this when they want to disable endpoint audio effects, but these device-scoped keys are protected and should not be mutated blindly by the app.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: The app now fails closed as not applicable on protected MMDevices ACLs. This avoids partial writes and access-denied rollback noise, but it also means this card is not an actionable end-user tweak.
setting.professional_notes: The current app still exposes this card through app/Services/TweakProviders/AudioTweakProvider.cs, but engine/Tweaks/Peripheral/AudioEnhancementsTweak.cs now guards it as not applicable when MMDevices endpoint enhancement keys are protected. 2026-05-08 VM probes confirmed both root-level and per-device MMDevices writes return access denied, so this record is rejected for research-provider promotion.

evidence.title: RegProbe app QA protected-ACL not-applicable proof for peripheral.audio-disable-enhancements
evidence.summary: Status not-applicable: the app detected protected MMDevices audio endpoint enhancement keys, reported 6 protected device-scoped target values, skipped apply/verify/rollback, and did not write the HKCU DisableProtectedAudioDG value.

decision.why: The current app mapping, documentation, failed 2026-05-07 mutation attempt, explicit 2026-05-08 per-device write probe, and redesigned 2026-05-08 VM app QA now agree: the MMDevices endpoint enhancement values are protected and this card should fail closed as not applicable rather than mutate.
decision.promotion_disposition_reason: Closed as rejected for research-provider promotion because the documented MMDevices audio enhancement endpoint values are protected by Windows ACLs on the current build, and the app now reports a truthful NotApplicable state instead of writing.
